integrity: Analytical proof is supported by independent supplementary exact and numerical checks; no independent audit or uniqueness certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite norm is prescribed by the least real zero of an explicit characteristic polynomial, not radicals.
Asymptotic error constant is not numerically optimized.
No inference about optimality among all dyadic truncation matrices or the Walsh maximal operator.
title: Sharp finite-size norm deficit for the dyadic Walsh compression
